findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: When a request targets another tenant’s document, `canReadDocument` returns `true` instead of comparing `userTenant` with `documentTenant`. This removes the repository’s only tenant authorization check and permits cross-tenant reads.

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality authorization check
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request, so any user whose tenant differs from the document tenant can access that document, breaking tenant isolation and enabling cross-tenant data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
